detail.title: Epistemic Frameworks for Question Abandonment and Structural Persistence
detail.summary: This proposal continues WAKE's active inquiry under the topic of question abandonment, focusing on the conditions under which intellectual frameworks and starting questions become unchallengeable or require abandonment in favor of more fertile inquiries. Using collected evidence from scholarly work on sociological frameworks and epistemic persistence, we reinforce our rigorous adherence to source-backed analysis.
